notes.title: Forgotten Hill First Steps is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We promised, it took a little while more than expected, but finally the first three original Forgotten Hill games are available on Steam!

Forgotten Hill First Steps is not a simple anthology of the older games, we've upgraded some visuals and joined them together with brand new contents, new puzzles and new secrets...

Get it now and let us know what you think:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425130/Forgotten_Hill_First_Steps/

By the way, the game is also available on mobile, choose you favorite device!

[url=https://www.forgotten-hill.com/first-steps/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39162851/98cae3c8dbeec87ec9564ef70664ad73cec3604c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Trading Cards are now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
we are happy to announce that Steam Trading Cards are finally available in Forgotten Hill Disillusion!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35557124/3bddef8d32252e32f25ed3b98c746d5c26e9e21a.png[/img]

There are a total of 10 Trading Cards, 3 profile backgrounds and a set of 5 Forgotten Hill emoticons, get them all!

notes.title: Forgotten Hill Disillusion out now!
notes.notes:
After 18 months of development, 5,482 cups of coffee and 432 4-formaggi pizzas we are glad to announce that Forgotten Hill Disillusion is now available on Steam and on mobile stores!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133930/Forgotten_Hill_Disillusion/

Get it now and let us know what you think, your feedback is very important for us

notes.title: Forgotten Hill Disillusion Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
after a long wait, we can finally announce the Official Release Date for Forgotten Hill Disillusion, the newest installment of Forgotten Hill games series. 

If you have 60 seconds of time you can have a look at our newest video, where we shared some numbers about Forgotten Hill Disillusion, and release date is one of them!

[previewyoutube=2uCfCBSgw9A;full][/previewyoutube]

To summarize you can meet again Mr. Larson again and discover what's lurking inside the Museum of Forgotten Hill starting from [b]November 20, 2019[/b]!

Wishlist now and don't forget the Demo is already available!

notes.title: FORGOTTEN HILL DISILLUSION DEMO NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
we are happy to announce that the Demo of Forgotten Hill Disillusion is now available to download for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35557124/001f860136ca9a77812ceba27fc21c58496a0937.png[/img]

You will act once again as Mr. Larson, will guide him inside the Museum of Forgotten Hill and start exploring the first section: [b]The Library[/b]. 
You will get to know new characters, solve puzzles and get used to some new features such us the Document Manager and... 
well, stop spoilers, download it now and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133930/
